# defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure (List Resource)

Lists the DefectDojo CI/CD infrastructure objects, ordered by ID. `description` and `url` are only read for users with the view or change permission.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the CI/CD infrastructure objects, and generate import blocks and
# configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure" "all" {
  provider = defectdojo
}

# Only build servers whose name contains "jenkins", ignoring case
list "defectdojo_cicd_infrastructure" "jenkins" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    infrastructure_type = "build_server"
    name_contains       = "jenkins"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `infrastructure_type` (String) Only list the objects of this type: `scm_server`, `build_server` or `orchestration`.
- `name_contains` (String) Only list the objects whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
